head: c1f9a612
note: Not a qualification or release label. Exercises the three contract goldens against the real pages over the local wigolo daemon.

transport_decompression.meaning: The server really sends gzip with the documented 1f8b0800 signature; the reader now returns real HTML instead of binary garbage.

structured_tables.meaning: The release version that lives in the page table survives extraction; a non-existent sibling version is correctly absent.

author_byline.meaning: A page with no byline reports empty (never guessed); a page with an author keeps it.

release_link_discovery.meaning: A real release URL is discovered from the actual official page and ranks first; discovery is a ranking preference and carries the URL as provenance.

limitations: Single run per URL; no repeat/stability sampling.
Release-link discovery validated on one official page only.
Not a semantic-adequacy or release label.
